name: Feedback extractor — daily drain of user comments → beliefs
notes: Daily drain of unprocessed feedback.comment pods into the belief store. Fires once in the 04:00-05:00 local window — early enough that the morning's belief snapshot reflects yesterday's user comments. Reads queue via list_recent_unprocessed_comments; LLM extracts belief updates; BeliefStore.upsert_belief writes them; comment pods get marked processed_at_utc. Fast-paths and returns early when the queue is empty (no LLM call). on_error.auto_retry_after_seconds=3600 lets the routine self-heal if a transient failure (DB lock, LLM hiccup) disables it.
